label: Prototype risk index (IMD-style criteria) - NOT an official IMD heatwave declaration
verification_note: Thresholds are recalled from published IMD heatwave criteria (plains 40C, coastal 37C, hills 30C; departure from normal >=4.5C heatwave / >=6.5C severe; absolute >=45C / >=47C in plains). They could NOT be verified online while building this prototype. Verify against the current IMD manual before any real use; all values here are editable.
